sources.title: Unemployed persons, by age and sex
sources.variables: Both sexes; age 15–74 and selected age groups; unemployed persons (1,000) and unemployed as per cent of labour force
sources.transformations: No statistical transformation in the local recent extract. Display formatting only. Long-context series is requested from the SSB PxWebApi v2 when available.

sources.title: Labour force, employment, unemployment and man-weeks worked, break and seasonally adjusted figures
sources.period: monthly from 2006; current release through July 2026
sources.variables: Both sexes, age 15–74; unemployment count and unemployment rate; trend, seasonally adjusted, 3-month moving average and not seasonally adjusted
sources.transformations: The table itself contains break-adjusted series. The page does not calculate seasonal adjustment.

breaks: 2006Q1: lower age limit changed from 16 to 15 years; SSB reports unemployment down by about 1,000 as a consequence of the production-system change.
2018: new estimation method introduced and StatBank series revised back to 2006.
2021Q1: major LFS redesign. SSB estimates a break of about 5,400 unemployed persons (not statistically significant) and 0.1 percentage points in the unemployment rate.
uncertainty: The LFS is sample-based. No numeric confidence interval is fabricated in this teaching page. The uncertainty-band illustration is explicitly conceptual.
